basic_profile.bio: I'm a tech enthusiast and a part-time delivery driver based in San Francisco, CA. I love exploring new gadgets and often discuss smartphone technology on Reddit. I've been delivering with DoorDash for over three years, which has become a primary source of extra income. When I'm not working, I enjoy watching Bayern Munich matches and diving into interactive story-driven games. I'm currently single and usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work, often between 8 PM and midnight.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in IT with a degree in Computer Science. My knowledge of smartphones and apps comes from personal interest and extensive usage. I keep up-to-date with the latest tech trends through forums and tech news sites, and I have a strong understanding of app functionalities across different platforms.
